    def uses_minmax(obj: Any) -> bool:
        if isinstance(obj, dict):
            if (obj.get("type") == "Call" and
                    obj.get("func") in ("min", "max") and
                    len(obj.get("args", [])) == 2):
                return True
            vals = list(obj.values())
            n = len(vals)
            i = 0
            found = 0
            #@ loop invariant 0 <= i and i <= n
            #@ loop invariant found == 0 or found == 1
            #@ loop variant n - i
            while i < n:
                if IRScanner.uses_minmax(vals[i]):
                    found = 1
                i += 1
            return found == 1
